requirement_text: Ensure confidentiality of data at rest
notes: Enforce encrypted StorageClass reference

requirement_text: Ensure integrity and confidentiality of data in transit
notes: Enforce TLS on all external-facing endpoints
Block wildcard resource permissions in RBAC
Block direct cluster-admin bindings to service accounts

requirement_text: Detect anomalies and potential ICT incidents
notes: Require securityContext with audit-capable settings

requirement_text: Ensure ICT system resilience and continuity
notes: Enforce CPU/memory requests and limits on all containers

requirement_text: Ensure high availability of critical services
notes: Enforce minimum replica count >=2 for production workloads
Require at least one NetworkPolicy per namespace

requirement_text: Ensure data integrity through immutable deployments
notes: Block 'latest' tag; require digest or semver
Enforce runAsNonRoot and drop ALL capabilities
Block privileged containers and hostPID/hostNetwork
Require standard labels (owner; team; dora-article) on all resources

requirement_text: Identify and classify ICT assets by criticality
notes: Require criticality label (high/medium/low) on workloads
Requires organisational process — cannot be enforced via admission
Require change-ticket annotation on deployments

column11: Governance process — outside admission control scope

requirement_text: Implement ICT asset protection and prevention
notes: Enforce readOnlyRootFilesystem and seccomp profile

requirement_text: Restrict access to ICT resources by authorised staff only
notes: Block pods using the default ServiceAccount

requirement_text: Implement ICT logging and monitoring capabilities
notes: Verify logging agent present (annotation or sidecar check)

requirement_text: Test ICT resilience through scenario testing

notes: Verify container image signatures via Cosign/Notary

requirement_text: Restrict container images to approved registries
notes: Allow only pre-approved container registries
Require SealedSecret or external-secrets-operator instead of plain Secrets
Require PodDisruptionBudget for critical workloads
Require description annotation on all workloads
